author: HR agent
text: Maurice Perez is an Engineer. Based on the access policy for full-time employees, they are eligible for write access to systems they do not own.

author: Security agent
text: Maurice Perez is a contractor with basic security training. According to the policy, contractors can have read access, but only write access if they have advanced security training. Since he only has basic training, the maximum access level allowed is read. Request for write access is above his maximum allowed level, so I recommend granting the maximum possible: read.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors are limited to read or write (if advanced training exists) and never admin. Since they requested admin, I recommend the maximum allowed for their status, which is read (given basic training). However, policy says contractors can have write if they have advanced training. Since they only have basic, the maximum is read.
